new_claim.statement: For independent real Xi with probability densities bounded by 1, normalized coefficients sum a_i^2=1, and max_i a_i^2<=4/9, the linear aggregate sum a_i Xi has a continuous density bounded by sqrt(6/pi).
proof_inputs: Konig-Koldobsky Proposition 7 sinc integral for p>=9/4, arXiv:1806.08659
Holder with p_i=1/a_i^2 and Fourier inversion

partner_application.inequality: If both normalized disjoint banks have max leverage <=4/9, then ||p_Q||_infinity <= 6(6/pi)^(2/3)|det K|^(-1/3), continuously.

strict_N3_application.scope: For any fixed 0<tau<=4/9, choose both bank leverage caps <tau. Then every physical diagonal is zero and every physical 2x2 principal determinant has magnitude <tau, so the family lies in strict N3.

non_transfers: Banks-Garza-Vargas-Kulkarni-Srivastava is bilinear-plus-affine and does not absorb arbitrary same-side quadratic curvature.
Meka-Nguyen-Vu Theorem 1.8 is fixed-scale and multilinear; it does not imply the linear-in-window estimate needed for an output L-infinity density and does not cover diagonal square terms.
remaining_gap: Arbitrary N3 still needs a product-preserving structural extraction into a diffuse/ridge, determinant/pair, grouped zero-pivot, or other already-paid branch. No fixed-minor extraction is asserted.
correction_refresh: Live CORRECTION_INBOX reread after proof; no listed correction invalidates the theorem or its partner application.
